# cache

Every cache, each with a budget: RAM frame cache, GPU texture cache, disk render cache, proxies, thumbnails and waveforms. Least-recently-used items are dropped first.

## Status

Phase 4 in progress: waveforms, clip thumbnails and proxies are done (frames kept on the graphics card are `engine::frames`). The frame cache in memory and the disk render cache come next; the timeline's cache bar (`ui_kit::timeline::cache_bar`) is where they will show what is ready.

## Files

| File | What it holds |
|---|---|
| `src/waveform.rs` | `peaks(path, stream)`: the loudest sample in each 1/100 s of a sound stream, read once on a worker at the stream's own rate (a 20-minute stream is 120,000 numbers, kept in memory). `peaks_of_streams`: several streams of a file in one pass over it (`media::AudioStreams`). `Store`: peaks kept on disk by the recording's fingerprint and stream, 16 bits a peak (a three-hour stream is about 2 MB), the least recently used trimmed to a budget. `peaks_as_read` hands the peaks over a few seconds of sound at a time while reading, for progress and for drawing the waveform as it fills in, and can be stopped |
| `src/proxy.rs` | Proxies (`docs/research/caching.md`, step 3). `Shelf`: the folder of proxies in the app's cache folder, one per recording and picture stream, named by the file's fingerprint (`file_for`), shared by the interface and the preview worker: the mode (`ProxyMode`: Off, On, Auto, a setting) and a counter that changes whenever a proxy comes or goes (`generation`) are atomics. `ready` (one that is built and not being deleted), `build` (writes `media::proxy` to a file of its own and puts it in place when complete), `used` (a proxy's last use is its file's time of change), `delete` (no longer offered at once; the file goes as soon as no preview has it open), `trim` (drops the ones used longest ago, never the open project's, to stay inside a budget in bytes; removes builds a program left behind), `usage` (bytes and count, of some proxies or all) and `clear` (removes some proxies or all, as `delete` does, waiting for a preview to let go; clearing all also removes builds left behind; only proxy files are ever touched; returns a `Cleared`: what went, where, and why some proxy could not). A proxy cleared on purpose is remembered for good in `cleared.txt` in the folder (one proxy name a line, written whole and put in place): `is_cleared` says so, so it is not built again by itself; `delete` sets the same mark (deleted on purpose); `build` and `unmark_cleared` take it off. `judge`: whether Auto builds one for a file, from its longest stretch between key frames and 30 frames' decoding timed here: over 50 ms for a typical jump, it does. Proxies belong to recordings, not projects, so they are not in `project::side_files` |
| `src/thumbs.rs` | `strip(path, stream, …)`: small pictures (fitted into 160×90) every 2 s or more along a video file, at most 300 per file, for drawing inside clips; tells its progress after each picture. Where the key frames are at most half the pictures' spacing apart (a long recording), each picture is the key frame nearest its moment, one frame decoded per picture (about 40 times quicker on a recording with key frames 4 s apart) |
| `build.rs` | Linux debug builds: the tests find the fetched FFmpeg libraries |
